title: C++ Exception Handling
description: Throwing, catching and unwinding: handler matching, standard and custom exception types, noexcept, and RAII-based cleanup.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 拋出、捕捉與堆疊展開：處理器的配對、標準與自訂例外型別、noexcept，以及以 RAII 為基礎的資源清理。

questions.prompt: Inside a catch block, what does a bare `throw;` do?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 catch 區塊內，單獨一個 `throw;` 會怎樣？

a.zh-Hant: 重新拋出目前處理中的例外，保留其動態型別

b.zh-Hant: 拋出一個新的 std::exception 物件

c.zh-Hant: 甚麼都不做，繼續執行 catch 之後的程式

explanation.zh-Hant: 不帶運算元的 `throw;` 會重新拋出目前處理中的例外物件，外層處理器看到的型別與狀態不變；適合在部分處理或記錄後使用。

options.text: It rethrows the exception currently being handled, preserving its dynamic type.
It throws a new std::exception object.
It does nothing and continues after the catch block.
It calls std::terminate immediately.

questions.explanation: `throw;` with no operand rethrows the active exception object, so an outer handler sees the same type and state. Use it after partial handling or logging.

questions.prompt: Which header defines std::runtime_error and std::out_of_range?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個標頭檔定義了 std::runtime_error 與 std::out_of_range？

explanation.zh-Hant: <stdexcept> 定義 logic_error 與 runtime_error 兩個繼承體系；<exception> 只宣告 std::exception 與 std::terminate，<system_error> 提供 error_code 機制。

options.text: <stdexcept>
<exception>
<cstdlib>
<system_error>

questions.explanation: <stdexcept> defines the logic_error and runtime_error hierarchies. <exception> only declares std::exception and std::terminate, and <system_error> provides the error_code machinery.

questions.prompt: When an exception propagates, destructors of fully constructed local objects run, which is what makes RAII cleanup safe.

prompt.zh-Hant: 例外向外傳播時，已完整建構的區域物件會執行解構函式，這正是 RAII 清理得以安全的原因。

explanation.zh-Hant: 堆疊展開會銷毀所有離開作用域的自動物件，因此智慧指標或 lock_guard 在函式因例外而結束時仍會釋放資源。

questions.explanation: Stack unwinding destroys every automatic object whose scope is exited, so a smart pointer or a lock_guard still releases its resource when a function exits by exception.

questions.prompt: Marking a function `noexcept` makes the compiler reject any `throw` statement in its body.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把函式標記為 `noexcept` 後，編譯器會拒絕函式體內任何 `throw` 敘述。

explanation.zh-Hant: `noexcept` 函式體內的 `throw` 仍可編譯，但例外真的向外傳播時會呼叫 `std::terminate`；只有在常數求值情境才會是編譯錯誤。

questions.explanation: A `throw` inside a noexcept function still compiles, but if an exception actually escapes, `std::terminate` is called. Only constant evaluation makes it ill-formed.

questions.prompt: Which of these exception classes are defined in <stdexcept>? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些例外類別定義在 <stdexcept>？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: `std::bad_alloc` 定義在 `<new>`，不在 `<stdexcept>`。`invalid_argument` 與 `out_of_range` 衍生自 `logic_error`，`overflow_error` 衍生自 `runtime_error`。

options.text: std::invalid_argument
std::out_of_range
std::overflow_error
std::bad_alloc

questions.explanation: std::bad_alloc is declared in <new>, not <stdexcept>. invalid_argument and out_of_range derive from logic_error, while overflow_error derives from runtime_error.

questions.prompt: Which statements about matching exceptions to handlers are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於例外與處理器配對的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 處理器依序比對，第一個相符的會被執行

b.zh-Hant: `catch (...)` 必須放在最後，否則它之後的處理器永遠到不了

d.zh-Hant: 不論順序，基底類別的處理器一定優先於衍生類別的處理器

explanation.zh-Hant: 比對依序由上而下，因此最具體的型別要放最前，`catch (...)` 放最後；`std::runtime_error` 衍生自 `std::exception`，以 const 參考捕捉可避免物件切割。

options.text: Handlers are tried in order, and the first matching one runs.
`catch (...)` must come last, otherwise the handlers after it can never be reached.
`catch (const std::exception&)` also catches a std::runtime_error.
A base-class handler always wins over a derived-class handler, regardless of order.

questions.explanation: Matching is top-down, so list the most-derived type first and the catch-all last; `catch (...)` matches any exception, including types not derived from std::exception. A runtime_error is a std::exception, so a const-reference handler catches it without slicing.

questions.prompt: An exception is raised with the ____ keyword and handled by a catch block.

prompt.zh-Hant: 例外是用 ____ 關鍵字拋出，並由 catch 區塊處理。

explanation.zh-Hant: `throw expr;` 會建立例外物件並開始傳播，沿著呼叫堆疊尋找相符的 catch 處理器。

questions.explanation: `throw expr;` creates an exception object and begins propagation; catch clauses along the call stack are searched for a matching handler.

questions.prompt: Why should handlers take exceptions by const reference, and what goes wrong with `catch (std::exception e)`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 為甚麼處理器應以 const 參考捕捉例外？而 `catch (std::exception e)` 又會出甚麼問題？

model.zh-Hant: 以 `const&` 捕捉可避免複製並保留動態型別。`catch (std::exception e)` 會複製並切割例外物件：拋出的 `std::runtime_error` 會變成單純的 `std::exception` 值，衍生型別與其資料遺失，`what()` 可能只回報基底訊息。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵風險是物件切割：以值捕捉只複製靜態型別的部分；以（通常 const）參考捕捉則保留原始例外物件。

answer.model: Catching by `const&` avoids a copy and preserves the dynamic type. `catch (std::exception e)` copies and slices the exception: a thrown `std::runtime_error` becomes a plain `std::exception` value, so the derived type and its data are lost and `what()` may report only the base message.

questions.explanation: Slicing is the key risk: a by-value handler copies only the part belonging to the static type. A (usually const) reference keeps the original exception object intact.

questions.prompt: Which declaration lets you throw AppError, catch it as std::exception, and construct it from a message?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個宣告能讓你拋出 AppError、以 std::exception 捕捉，並用訊息建構？

a.zh-Hant: `class AppError : public std::runtime_error { public: using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };`

b.zh-Hant: `class AppError : private std::runtime_error { public: using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };`

explanation.zh-Hant: 公有繼承 `std::runtime_error` 才能被 `std::exception` 的處理器捕捉，繼承建構函式則提供 `(const std::string&)` 形式。私有繼承或未衍生的類別不會被 `std::exception` 處理器捕捉。

options.text: `class AppError : public std::runtime_error { public: using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };`
`class AppError : private std::runtime_error { public: using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };`
`class AppError { public: std::string message; };`
`class AppError : public std::runtime_error { AppError() = default; };`

questions.explanation: Public inheritance from std::runtime_error makes the type catchable as std::exception, and inheriting constructors provides the `(const std::string&)` form. Private inheritance and non-derived classes are not caught by a std::exception handler, and the implicitly private constructor in option d makes AppError unusable.

questions.prompt: When is a return value or std::optional clearly better than throwing an exception?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在甚麼情況下，回傳值或 std::optional 明顯比拋出例外更合適？

a.zh-Hant: 當失敗是熱路徑上預期會發生的普通結果

b.zh-Hant: 當錯誤必須跨越好幾層函式邊界

c.zh-Hant: 當失敗無論如何都不能被忽略

d.zh-Hant: 當函式是必須回報失敗的建構函式

explanation.zh-Hant: 例外適合罕見且不應被忽略的失敗。對於查詢未命中等預期結果，回傳狀態或 `std::optional` 成本更低且控制流更清楚；建構函式無法回傳值，正是例外發揮作用的地方。

options.text: When the failure is an ordinary, expected outcome on a hot path.
When the error must cross several function boundaries.
When the failure must not be ignored under any circumstances.
When the function is a constructor that must report failure.

questions.explanation: Exceptions suit rare failures that must not be silently ignored. For expected outcomes such as a lookup miss, a status or optional result is cheaper and keeps control flow visible; constructors are exactly where exceptions excel, because they cannot return a value.
